test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Regularity is a cause for a success in exams.

Some irregular students pass in the examinations.

**Conclusions:**

I. All irregular students pass in exams.

II. Some irregular students fail in the exam.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows.

solution: Conclusions: I. All irregular students pass in exams. → The conclusion does not follows. (As Some irregular students pass in the examinations) II. Some irregular students fail in the exam. → The conclusion does follows. (As Some irregular students pass in the examinations → Some irregular students fail in the exam) Hence, **only conclusion (II) follows**.
